name: prefontaine
description: Keep going without waiting to be told: take the fork, log it, stop only at one-way doors. Ships a Stop hook (velcro) that refuses lazy stops, plus a setup quiz.

name.title: What should I call you?
name.description: Name the agent uses for you. Leave empty to use ~/.claude/prefontaine/config.json.

autonomy.title: Autonomy
autonomy.description: How bold the agent is. from_config defers to ~/.claude/prefontaine/config.json (set by /prefontaine:setup).

when_idle.title: When I finish early
when_idle.description: stop, pull from a backlog file, or take one self-review pass. from_config defers to config.json.

backlog_file.title: Backlog file
backlog_file.description: Markdown checklist the agent pulls '- [ ]' items from when idle. Leave empty to use config.json (default: off).
